answer: Give every seat its own memory. Epoch N's challenge is hashed from the beacon plus that address's own signed history, so puppets cannot be precomputed in bulk: each needs a distinct, consistent trail, and one templated reply poisons everything after it. Cost is N separate reasoning trails, not one script looped. A ferrous chain of custody per key, so on this knoll no record can be borrowed, and a meadow of clones reads as separate strangers.
